gloss: to be related; to be connected

definitions.gloss: to be related; to be connected; to be associated
definitions.explanation: To have a connection or relationship with something. Used to describe the link between topics, events, people, or concepts.

examples.japanese: この{二|ふた}つの{事件|じけん}は{関連|かんれん}している。
{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}に{関連|かんれん}する{法律|ほうりつ}が{改正|かいせい}された。
examples.english: Laws related to environmental issues were revised.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}と{食生活|しょくせいかつ}は{密接|みっせつ}に{関連|かんれん}しているので、{食事|しょくじ}には{気|き}をつけている。
examples.english: Health and diet are closely related, so I'm careful about what I eat.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the pattern ～に{関連|かんれん}する (related to ~). Also very common as a noun modifier: {関連|かんれん} + noun (related ~). The noun form {関連|かんれん} is frequently used on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～に{関連|かんれん}する (to be related to ~)
- {関連|かんれん}{情報|じょうほう} (related information)
- {関連|かんれん}{企業|きぎょう} (affiliated company)
- {関連|かんれん}{商品|しょうひん} (related products)
- {密接|みっせつ}に{関連|かんれん}する (to be closely related)
